title: Emergency fund money for March 2026 storm damage
summary: On October 20, an administration official said no more emergency fund requests are expected for now, with about $78 million left in the fund. Since March the Council has authorized $42 million from it, and an administrator will work with departments on an itemized spending breakdown. In June, officials said about $100 million in storm projects, across 92 damaged sites, must be paid up front and were not really budgeted, so they expect a budget amendment in fiscal 27.
